sub_question: SQ2: What reports/data should the monitoring system generate?
summary: The system should emit a layered data taxonomy, not just a single AQI number: (1) real-time per-pollutant concentration + NowCast AQI; (2) PERSONAL exposure metrics — time/location-resolved and, crucially, activity-adjusted inhaled dose (ADD), because personal exposure diverges massively from the nearest ambient station; (3) historical trends & exceedance logs vs WHO/AQI thresholds; (4) periodic summaries; (5) alerts/forecasts; (6) an exportable machine-readable schema for the AI agent + clinician/EHR.
key_insight: The single most important output that separates a PERSONAL monitor from a public AQI app is INHALED DOSE, not ambient concentration. Peer-reviewed work shows personal exposure can differ from the nearest outdoor station by >1000%, and inhaled dose = concentration × activity-adjusted breathing rate × time (physical activity mediates dose — a jog in Moderate air can inhale more than resting in Unhealthy air). So the report must be time- and location-resolved (home/commute/work microenvironments) and PA-aware. A personalized PM2.5→respiratory-rate exposure-response has already been demonstrated in asthmatic adolescents, validating the symptom-correlation output.

3_historical: exceedance log vs WHO AQG + AQI breakpoints
6_export: machine-readable JSON/CSV for the AI agent

detail.why_personal_dose: Ambient station ≠ what the person breathes; ADD integrates concentration, mobility, and PA-adjusted inhalation rate. Gender/education/activity differences show up ONLY in dose-based metrics, not concentration-based ones.
detail.validation: arXiv 2301.06300 demonstrated a personalised PM2.5→respiratory-rate relationship in asthmatic adolescents in everyday life — the symptom-correlation report is evidence-backed, not speculative.

notes: Personal-exposure/inhaled-dose concepts (ADD, ambient≠personal, PA-mediation, microenvironment resolution) corroborated across 3+ peer-reviewed sources → strong. The 6-layer taxonomy is organized synthesis on top of those + prior cycles' data products. FHIR/EHR export noted as a forward pointer for SQ5.
